0022600173.text: The Philadelphia 76ers (7-1, 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East) carry a four-game winning streak into this matchup, and they are 3-0 on the road, while the Detroit Pistons (6-1, 1st in the Central and 2nd in the East) have won three straight and are 2-0 at home. Philadelphia is missing Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery) and Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), and Detroit is without Isaiah Joe (hip, bruise) and Jalen Duren (hamstring, strain). In the season series, the 76ers trail 0-1 in 2026-27 after a 106-93 loss in Philadelphia on October 25, and they were swept 0-4 by Detroit in 2025-26.
